mission.note: Standard reference mission transit time for 2026 Space Apps challenge

bone_loss_per_month.citation: NASA HRP Risk of Spaceflight-Induced Bone Changes (1.0 - 1.5% bone density loss per month on 4-6 month missions)

fitness_loss_at_full_adherence.citation: NASA HRP Risk of Reduced Cardiorespiratory and Musculoskeletal Fitness (10-12% average strength and aerobic loss on ISS missions under exercise protocol)

exercise_target_hours_per_day.citation: NASA HRP Standard Countermeasure (ISS crews exercise 1.5 hours a day, 6-7 days/week)

inter_individual_variation_high_loss_cre.citation: NASA HRP: Between 12% and 38% of crew lose more than 20% of their pre-mission fitness

zero_exercise_fitness_loss_multiplier.note: NASA notes fitness loss is mitigated by exercise; without countermeasures, microgravity deconditioning accelerates by an assumed factor of 2.2x

zero_exercise_bone_loss_multiplier.note: Without resistive loading (ARED), bone resorption is uninhibited

balance_sensorimotor_decay.citation: NASA Risk of Altered Sensorimotor and Vestibular Function (qualitative risk without published monthly loss percentage)
balance_sensorimotor_decay.note: Assumed gradual sensory reweighting in 0g with weekly sensorimotor score checks; lowest-confidence dimension

sleep_mood_coupling.citation: NASA HRP Hazards (Hazards feed off one another: sleep debt accumulates and deteriorates mood and cognitive vigilance)

environmental_interactions.citation: NASA HRP Hostile Closed Environment / JSC-66632

radiation_environment.citation: NASA HRP Space Radiation / CSA Monitoring Radiation (Tracked cumulatively, not forecast via exercise)
